# Regnskaber, flere valg og centralbanker i sigtekornet

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-10-27  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish Millionærklubben episode (EuroInvestor, sponsored by Saxo Bank) opens with Brazil's election: Lula's surprise win sent Brazilian stocks down 14%, which Per Hansen (Nordnet) called an overreaction. It then moves to the Danish earnings season, with Maersk's expected upgrade, a sceptical view of DSV's results and buyback, Gubra's 2030 strategy day, GN Store Nord's conglomerate discount and short interest in the Danish breweries. It ends on US big tech and the AI investment boom, including Anthropic's IPO prospectus, Microsoft's voluntary redundancy offer and Per's warning that AI infrastructure builders risk poor long-term returns. The view on the Danish market is cautiously positive, while both panelists are sceptical of AI valuations.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 GUBRA — Gubra | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars bought on Friday ahead of the 2030 strategy day in London and would hold for five years.

#### Reasoning

Guest Lars Svendsen bought on the bet that a costly London event means good news. He values the AbbVie and Boehringer deals and the shift toward its own obesity pipeline. He calls it a gamble with a five-year holding period and admits that many biotech projects fail.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the strategy day disappoints
- if its own pipeline projects fail
- if losses from its own projects grow without progress

> *"Så jeg købte faktisk nogen der i fredags"*

---

### 🟡 MAERSK-B — A.P. Møller-Mærsk | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Lars holds and sees short-term upside toward 30,000. Per thinks an upgrade in line with consensus is already priced in.

#### Reasoning

Consensus expects a 10-15% guidance upgrade. Lars thinks the stock can rise somewhat more, but a lasting rise needs a better economy. Per warns that missing the upgrade would hit the share price.

#### Sell Triggers

- if no guidance upgrade arrives
- if the economy weakens

> *"Jeg tror, den kan godt lidt mere."*

---

### 🟢 MOS — Mosaic | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars sits on a loss in Mosaic but plans to buy more after the fall.

#### Reasoning

Lars Svendsen sees the beaten-down fertiliser producer as a candidate to add to, despite weak profits and problems in Brazil.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Brazil weakens further
- if fertiliser prices keep falling

> *"det er en af de aktier, der er bumpet, som jeg har lagt til mig at købe nogle flere af"*

---

### ⛔ DSV — DSV | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Both panelists call the report weak and say the 15% rise came from a lower risk premium, not earnings.

#### Reasoning

Per grades the report 4 and says strong revenue did not reach the bottom line. Lars points to falling container and air freight volumes and terrible cash flow, and calls the buyback a gimmick.

> *"Så det, der har givet sig på kort sigt i DSV, det er ikke indtjeningsforventninger. Det, der har givet sig, det er risikopræmien."*

---

### ⛔ GN — GN Store Nord | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Per criticises management and the conglomerate structure, which lowers the valuation multiple.

#### Reasoning

A shrinking hearing share (18-20x earnings) against consumer electronics (10-12x) means a lower overall multiple. Investors doubt that GN can deliver.

> *"Jeg forstår simpelthen ikke, at ledelse og bestyrelse ikke forstår det."*

---

### 🟠 RBREW — Royal Unibrew | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Per thinks the 25-30% fall on the lost Pepsi contract was an overreaction. Short interest is high.

#### Reasoning

Per Hansen points to the company's long track record of creating value. The contract is about 13% of volume, and probably less of profit. Rising short interest is keeping the stock down.

#### Sell Triggers

- if more contracts are lost
- if short interest keeps rising

> *"så synes jeg jo, at det svarer ikke til det, som Royal Unibrew langsigtet har vist og dokumenteret"*

---

### 🟡 PBR — Petrobras | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars holds it. The high oil price and exports to China support it; the risk is state interference under Lula.

#### Reasoning

Lars says the stock is driven by the oil price. Per notes the state ownership and governance concerns.

#### Sell Triggers

- if state interference grows
- if the oil price falls

> *"Det er de to, jeg har"*

---

### 🟡 VALE — Vale | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Lars holds it as an iron ore play exposed to China.

#### Reasoning

Lars Svendsen says the stock is driven by iron ore prices and the economic cycle, not Brazilian politics.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Chinese demand weakens

> *"Det er de to, jeg har"*

---

### ⛔ CRWV — CoreWeave | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Per thinks AI infrastructure builders will fail to earn their returns, as in the 2000 broadband build-out.

#### Reasoning

Per Hansen compares this to the 2000 internet build-out, when the price of capacity collapsed. He expects the winners to be the companies building on top of the infrastructure, not the builders.

> *"så er det ikke dem, der bygger infrastruktur, der sidder med kæen"*

---
